whisper-type.title: Whisper rolls to the DM
whisper-type.description:
Determines if the rolls will be whispered to the DM.
In the case of Foundry VTT, the 'ask every time' option will use the setting in the chat box.

whisper-type-monsters.title: Whisper monster rolls to the DM
whisper-type-monsters.description: Overrides the global whisper setting from monster stat blocks

custom-domains.title: List of custom domains to load Beyond20
custom-domains.description:
Enter a list of custom domain URLs to load Beyond20 into.
One domain per line, you must include the http:// or https:// protocol and you can use wildcards for subdomains and path.
This can be used to send Beyond20 requests to sites that may independently support Beyond20.
For example: https://my-new-custom-vtt.com/*/game

roll20-discord-activity.title: Support Roll20 Discord Activity
roll20-discord-activity.description:
Integrate with Roll20's Discord Activity.
This requires opening Discord in the browser so Beyond20 can be loaded and communicate with the activity.

hide-results-on-whisper-to-discord.title: Hide roll results on D&D Beyond when whispering to Discord
hide-results-on-whisper-to-discord.description: Don't show the roll results on D&D Beyond when using whisper and sending results to "D&D Beyond Dice Roller & Discord"

hide-results-with-digital-dice.title: Hide roll results on D&D Beyond when using Digital Dice
hide-results-with-digital-dice.description: If using Digital Dice and no VTT is found, don't show the roll results on D&D Beyond.

roll-type.title: Type of Roll (Advantange/Disadvantage)
roll-type.description: Determines if rolls should be with advantage, disadvantage, double rolls or user queries
roll-type.short_description: Hold Shift/Ctrl/Alt to override for Advantage/Disadvantage/Regular rolls

choices.5: Always roll thrice (limited support on Roll20)

quick-rolls.title: Add Quick Rolls areas to main page
quick-rolls.description: Listen to clicks in specific areas of the abilities, skills, actions and spells to quickly roll them.

use-digital-dice.title: Use D&D Beyond's Digital Dice
use-digital-dice.description: Integrate with D&D Beyond's Digital Dice, rolling the dice on the screen and sending the pre-calculated results to the VTT.

auto-roll-damage.title: Auto roll Damage and Crit
auto-roll-damage.description: Always roll damage and critical hit dice when doing an attack

initiative-tracker.title: Add initiative roll to the Turn Tracker
initiative-tracker.description:
Adds the result of the initiative roll to the turn tracker.
This requires you to have a token selected in the VTT
If using Roll20, it will also change the way the output of 'Advantage on initiative' rolls appear.

initiative-tiebreaker.title: Add tiebreaker to initiative rolls
initiative-tiebreaker.description: Adds the dexterity score as a decimal to initiative rolls to break any initiative ties.

critical-homebrew.title: Critical hit rule
critical-homebrew.description: Determines how the additional critical hit damages are determined

weapon-force-critical.title: Force all attacks/damage rolls as Critical Hits
weapon-force-critical.description: Forces all attacks to be considered as critical hits. Useful for melee attacks against paralyzed enemies or using adamantine weapons against objects
weapon-force-critical.short_description: Useful for crit damage rolls or melee attacks against paralyzed enemies or using adamantine weapons against objects

update-hp.title: Update VTT Token HP
update-hp.description: When changing HP in D&D Beyond, update it in the VTT tokens and sheets

display-conditions.title: Display Condition updates to VTT
display-conditions.description:
When updating character conditions in D&D Beyond, display a message in the VTT chat.
If using Foundry VTT with the Beyond20 module, it will also update the token's status icons appropriately.

hotkeys-bindings.title: Define custom hotkeys
hotkeys-bindings.description: Set custom hotkeys for controlling Beyond20's behavior.

sticky-hotkeys.title: Sticky Hotkeys: no need to hold the button
sticky-hotkeys.description: Allows you to press a hotkey instead of holding it to toggle the assigned ability for the next roll.

roll20-template.title: Roll20 Character Sheet Setting
roll20-template.description:
Select the Character Sheet Template that you use in Roll20
If the template does not match the campaign setting, it will default to the Beyond20 Roll Renderer.

notes-to-vtt.title: Send custom text to the VTT
notes-to-vtt.description:
In the "Notes" or "Description" section of any item, action, or spell on the D&D Beyond Character Sheet, you may add your own custom text to be sent to the VTT as a message when you use that element's roll action.
To do this, format the text you wish to send as follows:
[[msg-type]] Put text you wish to send HERE[[/msg-type]]
Replace "msg-type" with one of the following: "before", "after", or "replace" depending on how you want to affect the message or action that would normally be sent to the VTT.

subst-vtt.title: Replace Dices formulas in the VTT
subst-vtt.description:
In Roll20 or Foundry VTT, if a spell card or an item or a feat has a dice formula in its description,
enabling this will make the formula clickable to generate the roll in chat.

subst-dndbeyond.title: Replace Dices formulas in D&D Beyond (Spells & Character Sheet)
subst-dndbeyond.description:
In the D&D Beyond Spell page or Character sheet side panel, if a spell, item, feat or action has a dice formula in its description,
enabling this will add a dice icon next to the formula to allow you to roll it.

subst-dndbeyond-stat-blocks.title: Replace Dices formulas in D&D Beyond (Stat blocks)
subst-dndbeyond-stat-blocks.description:
In D&D Beyond, if a dice formula is found in the stat block of a creature, monster, vehicle,
enabling this will add a dice icon next to the formula to allow you to roll it.

handle-stat-blocks.title: Add roll buttons to stat blocks
handle-stat-blocks.description: In D&D Beyond, adds roll buttons for abilities/saving throws/skills/actions to the stat block of a creature, monster or vehicle.

crit-prefix.title: Critical Hit Prefix
crit-prefix.description:
Prefix to add to the Critical Hit dice result.
It might be less confusing to explicitely show the crit damage

components-display.title: Components to display in spell attacks
components-display.description: When doing a spell attack, what components to show alongside the spell roll.

component-prefix.title: Component Prefix
component-prefix.description:
Prefix to the components display of a spell attack.
If displaying material components only, you may want to set it to 'Materials used :' for example

hidden-monster-replacement.title: Hidden monster name
hidden-monster-replacement.description: Text to use to replace the monster name and attack name for hidden monsters (whisper type)

combat-unknown-monster-name.title: Unknown monster name replacement in encounters
combat-unknown-monster-name.description: Replace monster names in the combat tracker when they can't be mapped to tokens. Leave empty to not replace it.

roll20-spell-details-display.title: Display Spell Details in spell attacks
roll20-spell-details-display.description: When doing a spell attack, display the spell's details (Roll20 only toggle)

roll20-spell-description-display.title: Display Spell Descriptions in spell attacks
roll20-spell-description-display.description: When doing a spell attack, display the spell's full description (Roll20 only toggle)

weapon-handedness.title: Always Show Weapon Handedness
weapon-handedness.description: On Versatile weapons, always show weapon-handedness, even if 1-handed or 2-handed is selected

roll-to-game-log.title: Send Beyond20 roll results to game log
roll-to-game-log.description: Send the roll results made by Beyond20 (not in the VTT) to the D&D Beyond Game Log

vtt-tab.title: Select the VTT tab or Game to send rolls to
vtt-tab.description:
Select the tab to send rolls to or the specific Game.
You can select the Game or tab from the extension's popup menu in the VTT tab itself.
After a specific tab is selected and that tab is closed, it will revert to sending rolls to the same Game.

discord-integration.title: Discord Integration
discord-integration.description:
You can get rolls sent to Discord by enabling Discord Integration!
Click the link, follow the instructions and enter your secret key below.

discord-channels.title: Discord Default Destination Channel
discord-channels.description: Default Discord destination channel to send rolls to

show-changelog.title: Show Changelog when installing a new version
show-changelog.description:
When a new version is released and the extension has been updated,
open the changelog in a new window

last-version.description: Last version that was installed. Used to check if an update just happened

migrated-sync-settings.description: Whether the user settings were migrated from sync storage to local storage

last-whisper-query.description: Last user selection for query whispers

last-advantage-query.description: Last user selection for query roll type

sync-combat-tracker.title: Synchronize the Combat Tracker with the VTT
sync-combat-tracker.description: Overwrites the VTT's combat tracker with the details from D&D Beyond's Encounter tool (Roll20 only, GM only)

discord-display-description.title: Display description in Discord
discord-display-description.description: Display the roll's description in the Discord message

backup-settings.title: Backup Beyond20 settings
backup-settings.description: Export your Beyond20 settings to a file for backup

restore-settings.title: Restore Beyond20 settings
restore-settings.description: Import your Beyond20 settings from a previously exported backup file

donate.short: Buy rations (1 day) to feed my familiar
donate.title: Become a patron of the art of software development!
donate.description:
If you wish to support my work on Beyond 20 or my other D&D related project, subscribe to my patreon or donate via paypal!
I am grateful for your generosity!

donate-advanced.short: Buy rations (1 day) to feed my familiar
donate-advanced.title: Become a patron of the art of software development!
donate-advanced.description:
If you wish to support my work on Beyond 20 or my other D&D related project, subscribe to my patreon or donate via paypal!
I am grateful for your generosity!

migrated-sync-settings.description: Whether the user settings were migrated from sync storage to local storage

versatile-choice.title: Versatile weapon choice
versatile-choice.description: How to roll damage for Versatile weapons

toll-choice.title: Toll the Dead choice
toll-choice.description: How to roll damage for toll the Dead

custom-roll-dice.title: Custom Roll dice formula bonus
custom-roll-dice.description: Add custom formula to d20 rolls (Bless, Guidance, Bane, Magic Weapon, etc..)

custom-damage-dice.title: Custom Damage dice formula bonus
custom-damage-dice.description: Add custom dice to damage rolls (Magic Weapon, Elemental Weapon, Green-flame Blade, etc..). Use a comma to separate multiple independent rolls.

custom-ability-modifier.title: Custom magical modifier to raw ability checks
custom-ability-modifier.description: Add a custom modifier from magical items (Stone of Good Luck for example) to raw ability checks.

custom-critical-limit.title: Custom Critical limit
custom-critical-limit.description: Set a custom threshold for the critical hit limit (if using homebrew magical items)

effects-exhaustion-2024.title: Effect: Exhaustion 2024
effects-exhaustion-2024.description: Applies 2024 rules for exhaustion. This condition is cumulative and effects all D20 rolls applying a -2 * exhaustion level modifier to the roll.

effects-exhaustion-2014.title: Effect: Exhaustion 2014
effects-exhaustion-2014.description: Applies 2014 rules for exhaustion. This condition is cumulative and applies disadvantage on ability checks at exhaustion >= 1 and disadvantage on attacks and saving throws on exhaustion >= 3.

effects-bless.title: Effect: Bless
effects-bless.description: Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

effects-bane.title: Effect: Bane
effects-bane.description: Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target subtracks 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

effects-enlarge.title: Effect: Enlarge
effects-enlarge.description: Until the spell ends, the target also has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. While these weapons are enlarged, the target's attack with them deal 1d4 extra damage.

effects-reduce.title: Effect: Reduce
effects-reduce.description: Until the spell ends, the target also has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. While these weapons are reduced, the target's attacks with them deal 1d4 less damage (this can't reduce the damage below 1).

artificer-alchemical-savant.title: Artificer: Alchemist: Alchemical Savant
artificer-alchemical-savant.description: Use your Alchemist's supplies as spellcasting focus, dealing extra damage or healing equal to your Intelligence Modifier

artificer-arcane-firearm.title: Artificer: Artillerist: Use Arcane Firearm
artificer-arcane-firearm.description: Use an Arcane Firearm for your Artificer spells. Deals extra 1d8 damage

artificer-arcane-jolt.title: Artificer: Battle Smith: Arcane Jolt
artificer-arcane-jolt.description: Apply an Arcane Jolt to you or your Steel Defender's Weapon Attacks. Deals extra 2d6 damage, or 4d6 at Artificer Level 15+

bard-joat.title: Bard: Jack of All Trades
bard-joat.description: Add JoaT bonus to raw ability checks

bard-psychic-blades.title: Bard: College of Whispers: Psychic Blades (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
bard-psychic-blades.description: Use your Bardic Inspiration to deal extra psychic damage.

bard-spiritual-focus.title: Bard: College of Spirits: Spiritual Focus
bard-spiritual-focus.description: Use your Spiritual Focus to deal extra psychic damage, or apply extra healing

barbarian-rage.title: Barbarian: Rage! You are raging, ARRGGHHHHHH
barbarian-rage.description: Add Rage damage to melee attacks and add advantage to Strength checks and saving throws

barbarian-divine-fury.title: Barbarian: Path of the Zealot: Divine Fury
barbarian-divine-fury.description: Add Divine Fury damage to your attack (when raging)

barbarian-reckless.title: Barbarian: Reckless Attack
barbarian-reckless.description: Attack recklessly, giving advantage on your attack rolls, but granting advantage to attacks against you

cleric-blessed-strikes.title: Cleric: Blessed Strikes 2024: Divine Strike
cleric-blessed-strikes.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can cause it to take an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice). This Damage goes to 2d8 with Improved Blessed Strikes.

cleric-blessed-strikes-tasha.title: Cleric: Blessed Strikes 2014: Optional Rule
cleric-blessed-strikes-tasha.description: When a creature takes damage from one of your cantrips or weapon attacks, you can also deal 1d8 radiant damage to that creature. Once you deal this damage, you cant use this feature again until the start of your next turn.

cleric-circle-of-mortality.title: Cleric: Grave Domain: Circle of Mortality
cleric-circle-of-mortality.description: Manipulating the line between life and death, your healing on a creature with 0 hp is maximized

cleric-divine-strike.title: Cleric: Divine Strike
cleric-divine-strike.description: Deal an extra 1d8 (2d8 at level 14) damage to weapon attacks

druid-symbiotic-entity.title: Druid: Circle of Spores: Symbiotic Entity
druid-symbiotic-entity.description: Your symbiotic entity lends its power to your melee weapon strikes.

wildfire-spirit-enhanced-bond.title: Druid: Circle of Wildfire: Enhanced Bond
wildfire-spirit-enhanced-bond.description: The bond with your wildfire spirit enhances your destructive and restorative spells.

champion-remarkable-athlete.title: Fighter: Champion: Remarkable Athlete
champion-remarkable-athlete.description: Add Remarkable Athlete bonus to Strength/Dexterity/Constitution ability checks

fighter-giant-might.title: Fighter: Rune Knight: Giant’s Might
fighter-giant-might.description: Activate Giant’s Might to get advantage on Strength checks and saving throws and deal 1d6 extra damage

monk-diamond-soul.title: Monk: Diamond Soul
monk-diamond-soul.description: Your proficiency with ki aids you even against the grasp of death

paladin-improved-divine-smite.title: Paladin: Improved Divine Smite
paladin-improved-divine-smite.description: Roll an extra 1d8 radiant damage whenever you hit with a melee weapon

paladin-radiant-strikes.title: Paladin: Radiant Strikes
paladin-radiant-strikes.description: Roll an extra 1d8 radiant damage whenever you hit with a melee weapon or an unarmed strike

paladin-invincible-conqueror.title: Paladin: Oath of Conquest: Invincible Conqueror
paladin-invincible-conqueror.description: You can harness extraordinary martial prowess for 1 minute.

paladin-sacred-weapon.title: Paladin: Oath of Devotion: Sacred Weapon
paladin-sacred-weapon.description: Your charisma and deity guide your attacks

ranger-favored-foe.title: Ranger: Favored Foe
ranger-favored-foe.description: You mark an enemy and your attacks hurt them to an increased degree

fey-wanderer-dreadful-strikes.title: Ranger: Fey Wanderer: Dreadful Strikes
fey-wanderer-dreadful-strikes.description: Imbue your weapons and deal psychic damage to your the minds of your enemies.

ranger-dread-ambusher.title: Ranger: Gloom Stalker: Dread Ambusher (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
ranger-dread-ambusher.description: You skills in ambushing your enemies lend more damage to your initial strike

ranger-planar-warrior.title: Ranger: Horizon Walker: Planar Warrior
ranger-planar-warrior.description: Use your Planar Warrior ability to deal extra Force damage

ranger-colossus-slayer.title: Ranger: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
ranger-colossus-slayer.description: Use your Colossus Slayer ability and add 1d8 damage to your target

ranger-slayers-prey.title: Ranger: Monster Slayer: Slayer's Prey
ranger-slayers-prey.description: Use your Slayer's Prey ability and add 1d6 damage to your target

ranger-natural-explorer.title: Ranger: Natural Explorer
ranger-natural-explorer.description: Your familiarity with the current region aids in your exploration

ranger-gathered-swarm.title: Ranger: Swarmkeeper: Gathered Swarm
ranger-gathered-swarm.description: Use your Gathered Swarm ability to add extra Force damage to your attacks

rogue-sneak-attack.title: Rogue: Sneak Attack (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
rogue-sneak-attack.description: Send Sneak Attack damage with each attack roll

rogue-cunning-strike.title: Rogue: Cunning Strike (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
rogue-cunning-strike.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add Cunning Strike effects to the roll.

rogue-assassinate.title: Rogue: Assassin: Assassinate Surprise Attack (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
rogue-assassinate.description: Roll with advantage and roll critical damage dice.

rogue-assassinate-2024.title: Rogue: Assassin: Assassinate Attack (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
rogue-assassinate-2024.description: Roll with advantage and with extra damage.

sorcerer-trance-of-order.title: Sorcerer: Clockwork Soul: Trance of Order
sorcerer-trance-of-order.description: Align your conciousness to the calculations of Mechanus. You enter a heightened state.

eldritch-invocation-lifedrinker.title: Warlock: Eldritch Invocation: Lifedrinker
eldritch-invocation-lifedrinker.description: Your pact weapon drips with necrotic energy, lending extra damage to your strikes

warlock-the-celestial-radiant-soul.title: Warlock: The Celestial: Radiant Soul
warlock-the-celestial-radiant-soul.description: The pact with your Celestial enhances your radiant and fire spells.

genies-vessel.title: Warlock: The Genie: Genie's Wrath
genies-vessel.description: You genie patron lends their wrath to your attacks.

warlock-hexblade-curse.title: Warlock: The Hexblade: Hexblade's Curse
warlock-hexblade-curse.description: Apply the Hexblade's Curse extra damage on attack rolls and score critical hits on rolls of 19 and 20

warlock-grave-touched.title: Warlock: The Undead: Grave Touched
warlock-grave-touched.description: Your attacks become necrotic, and apply extra damage

wizard-bladesong.title: Wizard: Bladesinger: Bladesong
wizard-bladesong.description: Activate your Bladesong and make your weapon sing with magic

wizard-bladesong-2024.title: Wizard: Bladesinger: Bladesong (2024)
wizard-bladesong-2024.description: Activate your Bladesong: Advantage on Acrobatics checks, Intelligence for weapon attack and damage rolls, and Intelligence added to Concentration saves

empowered-evocation.title: Wizard: Evocation Wizard: Empowered Evocation
empowered-evocation.description: Your prowess in Evocation lends power to your Evocation spells

wizard-durable-magic.title: Wizard: War Magic: Durable Magic
wizard-durable-magic.description: While concenctrating on a spell, your savings throws are fortified

charger-feat.title: Feat: Charger Extra Damage (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
charger-feat.description: You charge into battle, lending weight to your blow!

healer-rerolls-feat-2024.title: Feat: Healer - Healing Rerolls
healer-rerolls-feat-2024.description: Whenever you roll a die to determine the number of Hit Points you restore with a spell or with this feat’s Battle Medic benefit, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

great-weapon-master.title: Feat: Great Weapon Master (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
great-weapon-master.description: Apply Great Weapon Master -5 penalty to roll and +10 to damage

great-weapon-master-2024.title: Feat: Great Weapon Master 2024 (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
great-weapon-master-2024.description: Heavy Weapon Mastery. Apply extra damage equals your Proficiency Bonus.

sharpshooter.title: Feat: Sharpshooter (Apply to next roll only, unless locked)
sharpshooter.description: Apply Sharpshooter -5 penalty to roll and +10 to damage

brutal-critical.title: Brutal Critical/Savage Attacks: Roll extra die
brutal-critical.description: Roll extra damage die on crit for Brutal Critical and Savage Attacks features

brutal-strike.title: Brutal Strike: Roll extra die
brutal-strike.description: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn.

protector-aasimar-radiant-soul.title: Aasimar: Protector: Radiant Soul
protector-aasimar-radiant-soul.description: Unleash your divine soul to deal extra radiant damage equal to your level.

motm-aasimar-radiant-soul.title: Aasimar: Celestial Revelation: Radiant Soul
motm-aasimar-radiant-soul.description: Unleash your divine soul to deal extra radiant damage equal to your proficiency.

halfling-lucky.title: Halfling: Lucky
halfling-lucky.description: The luck of your people guides your steps

druid-improved-lunar-radiance.title: Druid: Improved Lunar Radiance
druid-improved-lunar-radiance.description: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage to a target you hit with a Wild Shape forms attack.

druid-circle-of-mutation-circle-forms.title: Druid: Circle of Mutation - Circle Forms
druid-circle-of-mutation-circle-forms.description: Predator's Strike. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a Beast form's attack in Wild Shape, you add +2 to the damage dealt.

discord-target.title: Discord Destination
discord-target.description: Send rolls to a character specific Discord channel

motm-bugbear-surprise-attack.title: Bugbear: Surprise Attack
motm-bugbear-surprise-attack.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, the creature takes an extra 2d6 damage if it hasn't taken a turn yet in the current combat.
